blocks.text: Vera Rubin NVL72 每兆瓦性能领先 GB300 NVL72 最高约 5.7 倍

inlines.text: Vera Rubin NVL72 每兆瓦性能领先 GB300 NVL72 最高约 5.7 倍

blocks.text: Vera Rubin NVL72 延续了 GB300 NVL72 的机架级设计，在单个 NVLink 域中集成 72 个 GPU 和 36 个 CPU。每个 Rubin GPU 拥有与 Blackwell Ultra 相同的 288 GB 内存，但内存带宽提升 2.4 倍（得益于 HBM4），NVLink 带宽提升 1.7 倍，密集 NVFP4 算力提升 2.3 倍，而 Vera CPU 将其与 GPU 之间的 NVLink-C2C 带宽翻倍，这条链路承载了所有卸载到 CPU 内存的 KV 缓存。

blocks.text: 下面每张图都将每兆瓦实测 GPU 功耗的总吞吐量与每用户输出速度进行对比。总吞吐量计入输入 token（缓存的和新预填充的）和输出 token，其中约 96% 为缓存输入，每用户速度是各请求的第 25 百分位数（p25），不含首 token 时间，这也是我们全文引用的速度。每个点代表设定智能体数量下的一个服务配置，箭头标出 Vera Rubin 相对 GB300 的最大领先幅度。

inlines.text: 下面每张图都将每兆瓦实测 GPU 功耗的总吞吐量与每用户输出速度进行对比。总吞吐量计入输入 token（缓存的和新预填充的）和输出 token，其中约 96% 为缓存输入，每用户速度是各请求的第 25 百分位数（p25），不含首 token 时间，这也是我们全文引用的速度。每个点代表设定智能体数量下的一个服务配置，箭头标出 Vera Rubin 相对 GB300 的最大领先幅度。

在峰值吞吐量下，Vera Rubin NVL72 在 DeepSeek V4 Pro 上每兆瓦服务 272M tokens/s，而 GB300 NVL72 为 239M（1.14 倍）；在 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 上为 571M 对 395M（1.45 倍）；在 GLM-5.2 上为 272M 对 201M（1.35 倍）；在 Kimi K3 上为 70M 对 56M（1.26 倍）

Vera Rubin 的领先在 GB300 吞吐量下滑之处最为明显：在 DeepSeek V4 Pro 上，每用户约 190 tok/s 时达到约 5.7 倍；在 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 上，约 580 tok/s 时达到约 5.4 倍；在 GLM-5.2 上，约 165 tok/s 时达到约 3.0 倍；在 Kimi K3 上，约 67 tok/s 时达到约 2.8 倍。在 DeepSeek V4 Pro 上，每用户速度从约 120 提升到约 165 tok/s，会让 GB300 损失其每兆瓦吞吐量的 81%，而 Vera Rubin 仅损失 16%

按每 GPU 计算，Vera Rubin 的领先幅度更大：峰值吞吐量下为 2.0 倍至 2.5 倍，在 DeepSeek V4 Pro 上每用户约 165 tok/s 时最高约 12 倍，在 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 上约 580 tok/s 时约 18 倍，在 GLM-5.2 上约 200 至约 310 tok/s 之间约 7 倍，在 Kimi K3 上约 176 tok/s 时约 7 倍
Vera Rubin 最快的配置在我们的排行榜上创下了 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（906 tok/s，所有模型中最快的结果）、GLM-5.2（408 tok/s）和 Kimi K3（255 tok/s）的最高每用户速度

blocks.text: 更高的能效降低了服务每个 token 的运营成本，而且随着 AI 数据中心越来越受限于可获取的电力而非可安装的加速器数量，它还能让同一数据中心服务更多 agent。例如，在每用户约 165 tok/s 的速度下，相同的 GPU 功耗预算在 Vera Rubin NVL72 上可服务的 DeepSeek V4 Pro token 数量约为 GB300 NVL72 的 5 倍。我们排行榜上的每一个数据点都附带了其背后的服务配置，可在我们的配置浏览器中查看，因此团队可以从针对自身硬件调优好的配置入手，而不必自行开展性能研究。

blocks.text: Vera Rubin NVL72 keeps the rack-scale design of GB300 NVL72, with 72 GPUs and 36 CPUs in a single NVLink domain. Each Rubin GPU has the same 288 GB of memory as Blackwell Ultra, but 2.4x the memory bandwidth (from HBM4), 1.7x the NVLink bandwidth and 2.3x the dense NVFP4 compute, and the Vera CPU doubles the NVLink-C2C bandwidth to its GPUs, which is the link that carries any KV cache offloaded to CPU memory.

blocks.text: Each chart below plots total throughput per MW of measured GPU power against per-user output speed. Total throughput counts input tokens (cached and newly prefilled) and output tokens, with ~96% of them cached input, and per-user speed is the 25th percentile (p25) across requests excluding time to first token, which is the speed we quote throughout. Each point is a serving config at a set number of agents, and the arrow marks Vera Rubin’s largest lead over GB300.

inlines.text: Each chart below plots total throughput per MW of measured GPU power against per-user output speed. Total throughput counts input tokens (cached and newly prefilled) and output tokens, with ~96% of them cached input, and per-user speed is the 25th percentile (p25) across requests excluding time to first token, which is the speed we quote throughout. Each point is a serving config at a set number of agents, and the arrow marks Vera Rubin’s largest lead over GB300.

At peak throughput, Vera Rubin NVL72 serves 272M tokens/s per MW on DeepSeek V4 Pro vs 239M for GB300 NVL72 (1.14x), 571M vs 395M on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1.45x), 272M vs 201M on GLM-5.2 (1.35x) and 70M vs 56M on Kimi K3 (1.26x)

Vera Rubin’s lead is largest where GB300’s throughput drops away, reaching ~5.7x on DeepSeek V4 Pro at ~190 tok/s per user, ~5.4x on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at ~580 tok/s, ~3.0x on GLM-5.2 at ~165 tok/s and ~2.8x on Kimi K3 at ~67 tok/s. Going from ~120 to ~165 tok/s per user on DeepSeek V4 Pro costs GB300 81% of its throughput per MW, compared to 16% for Vera Rubin

Per GPU, Vera Rubin’s lead is wider again: 2.0x to 2.5x at peak throughput, and up to ~12x on DeepSeek V4 Pro at ~165 tok/s per user, ~18x on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at ~580 tok/s, ~7x on GLM-5.2 between ~200 and ~310 tok/s and ~7x on Kimi K3 at ~176 tok/s
Vera Rubin’s fastest configs set the highest per-user speeds on our leaderboard for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (906 tok/s, the fastest result for any model), GLM-5.2 (408 tok/s) and Kimi K3 (255 tok/s)

blocks.text: Greater power efficiency lowers the operating cost of serving each token, and as AI datacenters are increasingly limited by the power they can draw rather than the number of accelerators they can install, it also allows more agents to be served out of the same datacenter. At ~165 tok/s per user, for example, the same GPU power budget serves ~5x as many DeepSeek V4 Pro tokens on Vera Rubin NVL72 as on GB300 NVL72. Every point on our leaderboard comes with the serving config behind it in our configurations browser, so teams can start from a tuned setup for their own hardware rather than running their own performance study.
